Set the string S to the value V for the specified length L starting at
position X. The function leaves the remainder of S unchanged.
Parameters:
  S - The string to modify (input/output)
  V - The string value to insert into S
  X - The starting character position in S where V will be inserted
  L - The number of characters in S to replace with V
